title: Unisex Husky – Not Yelling. Just Husky. Hoodie

seo.title: Husky Hoodie – Not Yelling. Just Husky.
seo.description: A funny husky hoodie for husky people: NOT YELLING. JUST HUSKY. A howling husky and an empty bowl. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

NOT YELLING. JUST HUSKY. is the husky hoodie for husky owners and their families, worn to the dog park, the snowy walk and every video call where the dog will not stop talking.

NOT YELLING. runs across the top in heavy rounded capitals and JUST HUSKY. fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a grey-and-white husky sits upright with its head thrown back in a long, dramatic howl, one front paw raised in protest beside an empty steel food bowl, its bushy tail curled behind it.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the dog; Sand gets slate-black and faded red lettering. It also makes a gift for the husky's people. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this hoodie warm enough for a snowy dog walk?
Yes. The Not Yelling. Just Husky. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for snowy walks, chilly dog-park mornings and long evenings on the couch.

How does the Not Yelling. Just Husky. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier, cozier layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk at all.

Is this a good gift for a husky owner?
It is a natural one. Anyone who lives with a husky knows the dramatic howl at dinner time, so it lands with owners, families and friends. The Graphic Tees Co. hoodie comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the howling husky sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Not Yelling. Just Husky. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
